products.name: Bunty Chai
products.short: Hamari signature dholki-style chai — subah ki pehli sip, poore din ki raunaq.
products.about: Bunty Chai hamari jaan hai. Doodh patti ki buniyad par chhota sa twist — halki si elaichi, aur kaafi si mohabbat. Subah 8 baje iska pehla pot toot-ta hai aur shuru hota hai apna din.

products.name: Doodh Patti
products.short: Gadhi doodh wali classic — jis ka har ghoont aapko ghar ki yaad dilaye.
products.about: Sangeeli doodh, acche patti, aur bilkul sahi chini. Doodh Patti woh chai hai jo grandparents ke time se chalti aa rahi hai — aur hum usse abhi bhi waisi hi banaatay hain.

products.name: Masala Chai
products.short: Adrak, ilaichi aur darchini ka jadoo — mausam chahe kuch bhi ho.
products.about: Chaar masalon ka khufiya formula: adrak, ilaichi, darchini aur laung. Har ghoont mein aapko garmi ka ehsaas hoga jo thande mausam mein jaan daal de.

products.name: Kashmiri Chai
products.short: Pink gulabi chai — badam aur pista ki chadar, har sip mein sulah.
products.about: Kashmiri chai halki bhi nahi hoti — ye puri nazar hoti hai. Pink color, roasted badam-pista ki heaps, aur ek aqeedat ke barabar mehak. Isay thande mausam ka sukoon kehte hain.

products.name: Elaichi Chai
products.short: Ek ilaichi, do ilaichi… har cup mein khusboo ki mehfil.
products.about: Sab kuch saada hai, bas ilaichi ki quartet kamal karti hai. Ye woh chai hai jo lecture ke baad dil ko dheela kar ke rakh de.

products.name: Ginger Chai
products.short: Katti adrak wali chai — thaka sa badan, sab kuch theek.
products.about: Taza adrak ka ras, kadak patti, aur halki chini. Winters mein iske bina adhuri — aur summers mein bhi koi shikayat nahi.

products.name: Desi Kahwa
products.short: Zafran ki bukhar, kehwa ka sukoon — Doodh nahi, dil chaiye.
products.about: Green tea jo qehwa ke naam se jana jata hai — zafran, kishmish aur ilaichi ke saath. Khaas Peshawari style, aur har ghut mein sukoon ka andaz.

products.name: Karak Cappuccino
products.short: Espresso ke saath doodh ki pat, foam ka taaj — karak, par elegant.
products.about: Ek strong shot espresso, steamed milk, aur upar se fool-detailed foam. Chai ki qaum ke liye coffee ka taaruf — lekin strong cheez pasand aapko.

products.name: Hot Chocolate
products.short: Marshmallows ke saath Belgium dark chocolate — bachpan ka relaunch.
products.about: 70% dark chocolate, steamed milk aur mini marshmallows. Winters ki raat ka best partner, aur bachon ke liye bazaar se behtar.

products.name: Cold Coffee
products.short: Gadhi, meethi, thandi — wo wali cold coffee jo puri raat jaag jaye.
products.about: Blended coffee, doodh, ice cream ki halki si share, aur chocolate drizzle. Summers ka simple formula — thanda aur khush.

products.name: Chocolate Shake
products.short: Chocolate ka ziyada se ziyada — whipped cream aur drizzle k sath.
products.about: Dark chocolate ganache, doodh aur gelato — sab blended aur upar par creamy foam. Ye shake un logon ke liye hai jo "thoda kam" bolna h i nahi jaante.

products.name: Mango Shake
products.short: Sindhri mango ka mausam saal bhar — gaddha aur meetha.
products.about: Fresh Sindhri mangoes, thanda doodh aur malai ka lams. Jab mango season na ho to hum acha purana quality use karte hain — promise, swadd same.

products.name: Strawberry Shake
products.short: Taaza strawberries ka gulaab rang — halka sa meetha, pura dilkash.
products.about: Fresh strawberry puree, vanilla gelato aur doodh — blended to creamy perfection. Gulaabi shake jiski selfie lena farz hai.

products.name: Fresh Lemonade
products.short: Nimbu, podina aur soda — heat ka permanent hal.
products.about: Taza nimbu, chaat masala ki hint, aur thande soda ka jhag. Light, zingy aur bilkul refresh — chai ke baad ka dose.

products.name: Meethi / Khatti Lassi
products.short: Malai wali dahi se bani — meethi ya khatti, dono kahe — aap ki pasand.
products.about: Kadori mein dahi bilkul sahi kadar, malai ka dhaaga aur thandi roti ke saath. Meethi dunya chatapata, khatti thandi jhaans.

products.name: Mint Iced Tea
products.short: Green tea, podina aur nimbu — hawa ka jhoka, glass mein.
products.about: Green tea ko sakht kar ke thanda, podina aur nimbu ke sath — bina chini ki meethas, bilkul taza. Brunch ka sathi.

products.name: Aloo Samosa (2 pc)
products.short: Kadak coating, andar masala aloo — chutney ke saath jannat.
products.about: Har kone wala samosa, andar desi aloo ka masala jo handi mein pakaya jata hai. Chutney, tamatar sauces aur yaadon ka haath — sab kuch.

products.name: Chicken Samosa (2 pc)
products.short: Minced chicken masala ka pura package — crispy aur juicy dono.
products.about: Chicken ke saath adrak hari mirch aur secret desi masala — crispy outer, juicy andar. Aisay log bhi confirm hain jo light chaiyay.

products.name: Mixed Pakora (6 pc)
products.short: Besan mein aalo, pyaz, palak — barish ka sahara, barsaat hi ho.
products.about: Roz taza besan, saath mein mozgama sarson ka tel. Pyaz wale pakorey, aloo wale, aur palak waale — har kisi ki apni pasand hai.

products.name: Bun Kebab
products.short: Anday aur shami ka classic combo — Karachi se Lahore tak ka keemti nuskha.
products.about: Shami ke patty ko egg mein dooba kar tala gaya, bun mein anda aur tamatar, chatni aur dahi ke saath. Chai ka sab se loyal dost.

products.name: Chicken Sandwich
products.short: Grilled bread, juicy chicken, veggies aur secret sauce.
products.about: House-made kewpie-style sauce, taza salad aur aaram se grilled chicken. Sandwich bhi ho sakti hai level aisi.

products.name: Club Sandwich
products.short: Teesra layer har jagah nahi milta — ye wala khas hai.
products.about: Triple-decker: egg, chicken aur veggies teen layers mein. Fries ke saath toast hote hain — poori malaika night snack.

products.name: French Fries
products.short: Golden crispy, andar se naram — chai ke saath karari taali.
products.about: Double-fried perfection — bahar se karari, andar se fluffy. Paprika aur chat masala ka halka sa dusting. Order for the table, share with koi nahi.

products.name: Chicken Cheese Roll
products.short: Chatpata chicken, melted cheese, paratha roll — full package.
products.about: Bhuna chicken, pyaz ka lams aur cheese ka taar — parathe mein lipat kar tala gaya. Lunch, dinner, ya dosti ka maamla.

products.name: Egg Paratha Roll
products.short: Malida paratha aur anda masala — college wala sab se bara.
products.about: Naram malida paratha, bhuna anda masala, tamatar aur chutney. Canteen waala wajood — lekin quality aaj kal ki.

products.name: Gol Gappa Chaat
products.short: Crispy gappay, khatti meethi chaat — ek bite mein poori duniya.
products.about: Plated chaat: crisp puris, aloo-chana masala, dahi, imli chutney aur hari mirch ka teer. Desi chaat lovers ka corner.

products.name: Sizzling Brownie
products.short: Garami, chocolate, vanilla scoop — sizzle ke sath drama.
products.about: Brownie cooker par sizzle hote hue aata hai, upar vanilla gelato aur hot chocolate sauce. Kuch bhi nahi bolne ka — maza lo.

products.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
products.short: Dense, fudgy, triple-layer — meethas ka taaj.
products.about: Rooz taza banne wala cake — rich dark chocolate fudge, smooth buttercream aur bouncy sponge. Slice ya pura box, aap ki marzi.

products.name: Belgian Waffle
products.short: Crispy golden, toppings ki chadar — brunch ka hero.
products.about: Fresh waffle iron se nikla hua, chocolate syrup, nuts aur fruit ke saath. Kasi aap Nutella, kasi aap berries — choose karo.

products.name: Gulab Jamun (2 pc)
products.short: Naram gud ki andaaz mein — chini ki chashni, royoon ka jhoola.
products.about: Khoya aur maida — ghee mein halke tal kar chashni mein dooba. Garam garam wale hain sab se zyada maqbool.

products.name: Kulfi Falooda
products.short: Rabri, kulfi, falooda aur meethe sapne — ek glass mein parivartan.
products.about: Hand-churned kulfi, taza falooda, rabri aur meethi ya khushboo wali rooh afza. Sukoon ka poora package.

products.name: Choco Chip Cookie
products.short: Soft-center, gooey choco chips — chai ka sab se pyar card.
products.about: Salt-sweet balance bilkul sahi, andar raw-center wali chidiya no. Winters mein chai ke sath, summers mein doodh ke sath — dono sides covered.

products.name: Ice Cream Sundae
products.short: Teen scoops, sauce ki barish, nuts ki chadar — pure blis.
products.about: Vanilla, chocolate aur strawberry scoops — caramel aur chocolate sauce mein doobay, peanuts sprinkle. Bachon ki khushi, grown-ups ka excuse.

products.name: Rasmalai
products.short: Naram chenna, saffron doodh — mithai ka mumal dupatta.
products.about: Rabri mein doobay hui rasmalai, kesar k pista ke saath. Classic dessert jo kisi bhi daawat ko mukammal karta hai.
